defect.root_cause: app/gst_service.py::_build_tax_lines (lines 300-339) stores the full unsplit taxable amount on both the CGST and SGST TaxLine row for every intrastate charge; tax_snapshot() sums every row without the charge-level dedup that get_gst_report() applies (app/gst_service.py:705, 712-716).

direct_caller.note: tax_snapshot() is only ever invoked via full_report()['tax'] (through the memoising self._get() wrapper); no route/script calls tax_snapshot() directly.

ui_direct_render: app/templates/night_audit_panel.html:1190,1451-1465 (live audit screen, 'Taxable Amt' column and Total row)
export: app/reports.py:3618-3629,4056-4079 (_night_audit_excel — writes total_taxable and per-rate taxable into exported workbook)

verified_production_state.method: disposable copy via verification/dbcopy.py::make_copy(), same pattern as verification/_work/q06_repro.py; production sha256 confirmed identical before and after

persisted_verification_evidence.mechanism: verification/replay/engines.py:101-120 NAS_SECTIONS includes 'tax_snapshot'; probed and frozen per business date

verification_consumer.behavior: Computes both gst_service.get_gst_report()['total_taxable'] (deduplicated) and NightAuditService.tax_snapshot()['total_taxable'] (raw) per date, and records a Divergence at BLOCK severity whenever they differ by more than Rs 1. Does NOT compensate, average, or mask the gap; treats it as a defect to report.
verification_consumer.replay_engine_note: verification/replay/engines.py persists tax_snapshot()'s raw output into the replay ledger without dedup, by design (module is an honest replay of what the app returns, not a corrected figure).

report_export_consumers_confirmed_NOT_us.gst_einvoice.py: app/gst_einvoice.py consumes gst_data/gst_summary sourced from gst_service.get_gst_report() / get_folio_gst_summary() exclusively (module docstring: 'Caller passes data from gst_service.get_gst_report()'). Never calls tax_snapshot().

compensation_search.detail: Grepped app/ and verification/ for dedup logic, halving (/2, *0.5), and any special-casing of total_taxable/by_rate inside or around tax_snapshot(). No code compensates for the 2x inflation anywhere. The one /2 found (night_audit_panel.html:1455-1456,1463-1464) halves the already-correct total_tax to split a display column between CGST/SGST — an unrelated pre-existing UI convention, not a taxable-base fix.

persistence_finding.detail: tax_snapshot() is computed on demand for open/live audit dates, but its output IS persisted: (1) hash-sealed in NightAuditLog.snapshot_json in production for closed audit dates (1 row confirmed, date 2026-08-09, carrying the buggy 2285.7 figure), served back verbatim by app/routes.py:4786-4808 without recomputation; (2) frozen into verification/ledgers/production/dates/*.json by the replay harness for audit/regression purposes.

isolation_assessment.detail: self._tax_lines is read in only two places in NightAuditService: revenue_summary() (app/night_audit_service.py:567, uses t.tax_amount only, unaffected) and tax_snapshot() itself. total_tax is computed independently from tax_amount, which is already correctly split per row and needs no change. No other full_report() section re-derives a figure from tax_snapshot()'s total_taxable/by_rate.
isolation_assessment.caveat: A code fix only affects tax_snapshot() calls made after the fix. It cannot retroactively correct the already-frozen NightAuditLog.snapshot_json row for 2026-08-09 or the already-written verification/ledgers/production/dates/*.json files for 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-10 — those are immutable-by-design historical records.

stop_conditions.notes: One STOP-worthy item: production NightAuditLog id=1 (audit_date=2026-08-09, status=Completed, snapshot_valid=1) has a hash-sealed snapshot_json whose tax.total_taxable (2285.7) is the buggy ~2x-inflated figure, and app/routes.py:4786-4808 will keep serving that exact frozen JSON for that date regardless of any future code fix to tax_snapshot(). Whether/how to regenerate or re-flag that one frozen record is a decision for whoever authorizes the fix; not resolved or touched by this trace. No other STOP condition triggered.
